Guidance & outlook: Outlook Global growth is projected to slow from 3.3% in 2024 to approximately 3.2% in 2025 and 3.1% in 2026, according to the IMF's October 2025 World Economic Outlook.
The Current Account Deficit (CAD) moderated from 2.2% of GDP in Q2 FY 2024-25 to 1.3% in Q2 FY 2025-26, supported by strong services exports and robust remittances.

The RBI has progressively revised its FY 2025-26 GDP growth forecast upward - from 6.5% to 6.8%, and subsequently to 7.3% - citing stronger-than-anticipated quarterly performance, favourable domestic conditions, and easing financial conditions.
Growth & demand: Real GDP grew at 7.8% in Q1 FY 2025-26 and accelerated further to 8.2% in Q2, reaching a six-quarter high.
The growth has been broad-based, with the Secondary Sector (manufacturing) expanding 8.1% and the Tertiary Sector (services) growing 9.2% in Q2 FY 2025-26 on a year-on-year basis.
The Primary Sector also contributed with a 3.1% growth rate during the same period.
